title: ADR-0005 — CI/CD Security Quality Gates Rules
description: Machine-readable rules encoding ADR-0005 CI/CD Security Quality Gates. Mandatory gates for every merge to protected branches.
adrTitle: CI/CD Security Quality Gates with CodeQL

rules.title: CodeQL Static Analysis runs on every PR
rules.description: GitHub CodeQL must run on every pull request. Scans for OWASP Top 10 vulnerability patterns in TypeScript source code. PRs with High or Critical findings are BLOCKED from merging.
rules.rationale: ADR-0005 §Decision: Security enforced mechanically, not left to human review.
rules.validationQuery: CI pipeline includes CodeQL scan step. PRs with CRITICAL/HIGH findings cannot complete merge.

rules.title: Dependency vulnerability scan blocks merge
rules.description: npm audit --audit-level=high (or equivalent for other languages) runs in CI. Any dependency with a High or Critical CVE blocks the pipeline.
rules.rationale: ADR-0005 §Decision: Third-party dependencies can introduce known CVEs that go undetected without automated scanning.
rules.validationQuery: CI pipeline runs dependency audit. Pipeline fails on High/Critical CVE detection.

rules.title: Secret detection enabled on repository
rules.description: GitHub's built-in secret scanning is enabled on the repository to detect accidentally committed API keys or credentials. Commits containing secrets are rejected.
rules.rationale: ADR-0005 §Decision: Secret detection prevents credential leakage at the source.
rules.validationQuery: Secret scanning is enabled in repository settings. Pre-commit hooks detect known secret patterns.

rules.title: All quality gates execute before merge
rules.description: All quality gates (CodeQL, dependency scan, lint, tests, coverage) MUST complete successfully before a PR can merge. No merge with failing pipeline.
rules.rationale: ADR-0005 §Pipeline gates: Mechanical enforcement before merge.
rules.validationQuery: Protected branch requires all CI checks green. No override allowed without explicit waiver.

rules.title: Security findings documented with justification
rules.description: False positive suppressions require documented justification comments in code. Suppressed findings must include a reason and an issue tracker reference.
rules.rationale: ADR-0005 §Consequences: False positives require manual suppression with documented justification.
rules.validationQuery: Suppressed findings have inline comments explaining justification and JIRA/Ticket reference.

rules.title: Critical findings resolved within 24 hours
rules.description: All Critical severity findings from CodeQL or dependency scans MUST be resolved within 24 hours of detection.
rules.rationale: ADR-0005 §SLA: Critical findings require immediate response.
rules.validationQuery: Issue tracker has Critical findings with age <= 24 hours or explicit SLA waiver.
rules.enforcement: Issue tracker integration or automated escalation

rules.title: High findings resolved within 72 hours
rules.description: All High severity findings from CodeQL or dependency scans MUST be resolved within 72 hours of detection.
rules.rationale: ADR-0005 §SLA: High findings require timely response.
rules.validationQuery: Issue tracker has High findings with age <= 72 hours or explicit SLA waiver.

exitCriteria.description: All CI/CD gates pass. Protected branches enforce all checks. SLA compliance tracked.
